newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Henry Walker work in hand rises.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Henry Walker work in hand rises.

text.p: Contract miner and civil engineer Henry Walker Group Ltd said on Wednesday its work in hand had grown to A$890 million as at September 30 1996 from A$829 million at the end of the 1995/96 year on June 30.
Managing Director Ricard Ryan told reporters after the company's annual meeting that Henry Walker hoped to make some announcements on further contracts in the next few weeks.
"We are quite confident our contracting division will meet all its revenue targets this year," he said.
"Indications are at this stage we will and of course we are hoping to have the improvement on the bottom line as well," he said.
It was too early yet to discuss profit details, other than to say the company had traded on budget for the first two months of 1996/97, he said.
Henry Walker had previously said it was targeting a 10 percent improvement in profitability and revenue in 1996/97.
The company's net profit rose 14 percent to A$17.7 million in 1995/96 and it's contracting division achieved A$314 million in revenues.
Henry Walker chairman Neville Walker earlier told shareholders the company was aiming to establish financially self-sufficient businesses in both Indonesia and South America within five years.
An office wad shortly to be established in Buenos Aires where the company was persuing a couple of reasonably large strategic contracts, Ryan told reporters.
Henry Walker shares were two cents lower at A$2.58 at 12.30 p.m. (0230 GMT).
